overview: The City Council approved the FY2027 General Fund budget with a significant targeted reduction to the law department following an impasse over public records regarding legal settlements. The Council also established a new special education reserve fund and authorized various community preservation and infrastructure appropriations.

items.title: Resolution Celebrating Marie Cassidy
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Marie Cassidy on her retirement as director of the Medford Family Network after 33 years of service.

items.title: Reports and Records
items.summary: Approved various committee reports and meeting records from June 9 and June 11 as amended.

items.title: Withdrawal of Rent Stabilization Resolution
items.summary: Withdrew a resolution supporting rent stabilization efforts following a ruling from the Supreme Judicial Court.

items.title: Special Education Reserve Fund
items.summary: Approved the establishment of a special education reserve fund to mitigate financial volatility from unanticipated student needs and federal funding cuts.

items.title: Free Cash and Retained Earnings Appropriations
items.summary: Approved over $10 million in appropriations for stabilization funds, snow and ice deficits, union retroactive payments, and a project labor agreement study for the high school construction.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements and Takings
items.summary: Tabled orders for property takings and easements for the Main Street Corridor project until July 14 to allow for better public notification and technical review.

items.title: Public Records Appeal Resolution
items.summary: Authorized an appeal to the Secretary of State regarding the administration's allegedly deficient response to public records requests concerning legal settlements and litigation costs.

items.title: Affordable Housing and Medford Family Network Funding
items.summary: Approved free cash appropriations of $250,000 for the Affordable Housing Trust and $100,000 to bridge a funding gap for the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Food Truck Permits
items.summary: Approved food truck permits for summer events in Medford Square.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriations
items.summary: Approved $108,000 in CPA funds for emergency repairs at the Royal House and slave quarters and ADA improvements at Shiloh Baptist Church.

items.title: Curtis Tufts High School Assessment
items.summary: Approved $17,500 from the Capital Stabilization Fund for a capital needs assessment to support future use planning for the Curtis Tufts High School building.

items.title: Health and Human Services Personnel Amendments
items.summary: Approved on first reading ordinance amendments renaming the Health Department and establishing an Assistant Health and Human Services Director position.

items.title: FY2027 Budget and Supplemental Appropriations
items.summary: Approved the FY2027 General Fund budget as reduced, cutting the law department to two months of funding pending the release of litigation records. The Council also approved supplemental funding for library wages and legislative staff, while a motion for a 1/12th budget failed.

items.title: Non-Union Wage Adjustments
items.summary: Approved the non-union personnel ordinance wage adjustments for the upcoming fiscal year.
